name: mirage
text: Update: with live back on, tennis is now running through the same lane as other sports. The engine has 2 tennis matches live, 1 matched to Novig, 1 line watched. It judged that line 164 times and offered no bets: 98 times the Novig ask wasn't an old Pinnacle price, and 66 times Pinnacle's price hadn't settled. So the lane works and nothing is broken; the taker only bets when Novig lags a Pinnacle move, and there isn't one yet. The bid side judged 17 times and none is up. Both are still paper. It's a small sample, so please keep live on while more matches go in play. I'm still working on getting more Novig tennis lines matched, and on showing why each bid is or isn't posted.
